title: Storyteller conformance suite
description: suite.json: the version of the suite and every vector file with its kind. The schema of a kind is schema/<kind>.schema.json.

version.description: The SemVer of the suite. Major: an expected result changes, a vector is removed or renamed, a field changes meaning, or a schema rejects a file it accepted. Minor: a vector, a file, a kind or an optional field is added. Patch: a description or the README changes.

path.description: Relative to the folder of suite.json, with '/' between folders.
